annotations.title: Draft an AI policy for a small firm

description: Drafts a one-page AI use policy for a small UK firm: approved tools, what must never be pasted in, human checking, telling clients, and who is responsible. Use when an owner asks whether they need an AI policy, what to put in one, or how to stop staff pasting client details into AI tools. Returns the clauses and the steps to take before adopting it. A starting draft, not legal advice.

data.description: What information staff might put into AI tools. Use no_personal_data if none.

regulated.description: True if the firm is regulated by a professional or financial regulator.

teamSize.description: Number of people in the firm.

uses.description: What staff use or will use AI for. drafting_and_research; client_communication = drafting emails or letters to clients; meeting_notes = recording or transcribing meetings; decisions_about_people = screening candidates, assessing clients or staff.

name: draft_ai_policy
